outcome: Give saas cto / vp product engineering a governed method to improve p95 query latency using query traces, indexes and application releases, with final decisions retained by named staff.
overview: Cloud Database Query Performance Triage addresses telemetry is noisy or missing, so operators spend time interpreting unrelated warnings in technology and saas operations. The first proof of value uses query traces, indexes and application releases. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is p95 query latency, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: query traces, indexes and application releases; define p95 query latency and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from SaaS CTO / VP Product Engineering.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including inject sensor failures, stale data and dependency loss into the pilot.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
